## Checklist

- [ ] My change targets the **open-source core** (the Pro edition does not accept external contributions — see `LICENSING.md`).
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] My commits use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) and pass commitlint.
- [ ] All commits are **signed off** per the [Developer Certificate of Origin](../DEVELOPER_CERTIFICATE_OF_ORIGIN.md) (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have added or updated **tests** for my change, and the test suite, linter, and type-checker pass.
- [ ] I have updated relevant **documentation** (including `docs/client_docs/` for user-facing changes).
- [ ] This PR does **not** contain a security vulnerability report (those go through [private reporting](../SECURITY.md), not public PRs).
